audiences.executive: Know which cloud risks could reach the business, who owns each one, and that the tool bought is doing the work it was bought for.
audiences.technical: Every cloud account connected and seen, the capabilities switched on, each critical finding routed to the team that owns it, and accepted risks that expire.
audiences.financial: Get the value of the licences already paid for, and spend the team's hours on the few findings that matter, not on every alert.

people: The platform or cloud team that creates accounts
The application teams that own the findings
Security operations, for the alerts at run time
Governance or risk, for accepted risks

objections.says: We already have a cloud security tool.
objections.clarify: How many of your cloud accounts does it see today, and which capabilities are switched on?
objections.answer: Owning the tool is the start: count the accounts it really sees and the controls really on, and close that gap first.
objections.prove: Compare the accounts on the bill with the accounts the tool sees, and list the capabilities still off.

objections.clarify: When a critical finding was last raised, how did its owner learn it was theirs?
objections.answer: Route each finding to the team that owns the resource, in the tool they already use, with a date to decide by.
objections.prove: Route one week of critical findings to their owning teams, and count how many get a decision on time.

objections.says: Agents will slow down our workloads.
objections.clarify: Which workloads would you not put an agent on, and what would you watch on them instead?
objections.answer: See most of the estate without an agent, and add one only where run-time protection is worth it, measured first.
objections.prove: Run the agent on a test group for two weeks, and compare their response times with the group without it.

objections.says: We have thousands of findings already.
objections.clarify: Which of them sit on something exposed to the internet and reachable from a weakness?
objections.answer: Start from the few risks that combine exposure, a weakness and something worth reaching, not from the whole list.
objections.prove: Take the full list, keep only the exposed, reachable and valuable findings, and fix the first ten.
